@dogecoin_rise Capital gains tax is a bitch. If you sell more than 12300 worth of profit per year in uk you pay tax. Changes the more you make. So if it ever gets to $10 looks like il be getting a 12k bonus every year for life
@dogecoin_rise Why has it gained so much interest in the last few days? I didn’t expect it to fly up so fast.

@dogecoin_rise Everyone remember you’ve only lost money if you cash out low. If you really need the money then you’ve forgotten the 1st rule. Only invest what you can afford to lose and have a get out strategy. Otherwise hold it. It will come back.
